item.title: LOT-058: group MP members
item.body:
LOT-058
Refs #84 — left: **changing** a group's members (add/remove through an edited `newdest`), pending capture #507. Also still pending from #484: `nonlu.php` without a session or sent twice (#137), a multi-page conversation's mark-unread link.
Claim: ext/francoisgn-opus-4
Author model: Opus 5.5

### Problem
#484 left group MP members open, blocked on capture #336. #480 captured a group MP seen by its owner and by a member, but no POST from the owner's form.

### Cause
Only the owner's reply composer lists the other members (`newdest`, `R123c`); a member's has none (`R123e`), neither thread page shows them, a member sees them only in the MP list row title (`R123a`, `R123f`). HFR's answer to an edited `newdest` is not captured.

### Change
- `PostingForm.groupMembers` (HFRClient): the owner's roster from `newdest`, split on the comma and trimmed; nil on a member's or a one-to-one composer. Members use LOT-023's `PrivateMessageThread.interlocutors`, now tested on the group lists.
- A reply from the owner's composer sends `newdest` back as served, in document order, as legacy did (`R123c` oracle `post.pairs`). No API changes the roster: that waits for #507.
- No `HFRModels` change; no new dependency.
- Test support: the LOT-004 form oracle and LOT-002 list oracle loaders also read `Fixtures/M2-writes/`.
- Spec `docs/lots/LOT-058-mp-actions.md` and HFR-PROTOCOL §6c `### LOT-058` updated.

### Tests
- `GroupMembersTests` (new): roster of `R123c`; none on `R123e`, `R47b`, `R47u1`; roster + owner == `R123a` row; separators on an edited `R123c`; reply body keeps `newdest` between `pseudo` and `password` (owner), none (member). No answer is scripted.
- Differential against the #336 oracles: `HopFormOracleTests` (+`R123c`, `R123e`, `R123k`), `PostingBodyOracleTests` (+`R123c`, `R123e`), `PrivateMessageListParserTests` (+`R123a`, `R123f`); raw facts in `HopFormParserTests.groupComposers`, `PrivateMessageListParserTests.groupThreadRoster`.
- Mutations, each caught: roster never read (3 tests fail), split on ", " only (1), `newdest` dropped from the body (2, incl. the legacy differential).
- `swift test` 1503 tests green on Linux; `check-lot-deps.py` 0 violations.

### LEGACY FIXES
None (legacy never read the roster; it already sent `newdest` back). No CHANGELOG-LEGACY row.

### PENDING CAPTURE
- #507: the owner's reply with `newdest` unchanged, extended, reduced, emptied, unknown pseudo; thread and lists afterwards.
- #137: `nonlu.php` logged out / sent twice.

comments.body:
**Adversarial review (Claude Fable 5.1, `ext/francoisgn-fable-review-7`, independent of the author): APPROVE** — head `3f6ece625836e31c895cc02c1388f4a8672ebde8` (delta from 1046702: only the `m2` → `m2Cases` rename in `HopFormOracleTests.swift`, verified by diff)

Findings

1. Nit — `Packages/HFRKit/Sources/HFRClient/Posting/PostingForm.swift:67`: a served-but-empty `newdest` (not captured) yields `[]`, while the doc says only "nil when the form has none". Scenario: a UI keyed on `groupMembers != nil` shows an empty roster. Fix: document `[]` as "served empty, pending capture", or return nil for an empty value.
2. Nit — `docs/lots/LOT-058-mp-actions.md:4`: names `ext/francoisgn-opus-1` (#484) while the PR claims `ext/francoisgn-opus-4`; add the current session so the claim trail reads from the spec.

Checked

- `swift test` on 3f6ece6: 1503 tests, 182 suites, green.
- Five mutations, each caught: split on ", " only; `newdest` dropped from the body (also fails the R123c legacy-pairs oracle); roster never read; type-less input not `.text`; no trimming.
- Raw captures: R123c `<input size="25" name="newdest" value="user3, user2">` between `pseudo` and the hidden `password` row; R123e/R47b/R47u1/R123b/R123d have no `newdest`; R123a/R123f rows `title="user1, user2,user3"`. R123c oracle `post.pairs` carries `newdest=user3, user2`, R123e none; `origin/master` has no `newdest` at all, consistent with "legacy sent every input".
- Security: the reply is unchanged code; `newdest` is one `.text` control walked in document order, the action URL passes `isForumPage`, POST with `.doNotFollow`, no retry, no override API for the roster; nothing derives a host, path or topic from it; tests use scripted sessions only (LESSONS 56).
- Boundaries: HFRClient only, no `HFRModels` public change; Swift 6 clean; line lengths ≤ 140, no 2-char identifiers left.
- Docs: protocol §6c and spec claims trace to R123a/c/e/f and the oracles; `Refs #84` with what is left, `Claim:` present (equality with the issue's active claim not verifiable from the given inputs). The PR touches a state-changing flow's form: merge by orchestrator/maintainer per §8.
